overview.title: Sod Installation
overview.summary: Give your outdoor space a fresh start with a new lawn.
overview.description: Sometimes a yard is ready for a new beginning. Sod installation brings a fresh layer of green to your outdoor space. Tell us about your property and we’ll talk through the next steps.
overview.caption: A fresh start from the ground up.

detail.headline: A fresh start.
detail.introduction: Ready to give your lawn a new beginning? Talk with the Flores team about sod installation for the outdoor space you have in mind.
detail.sectionCopy: A lawn helps tie the rest of your property together. Whether you’re thinking about a new grass area or a fresh start for an existing space, we’ll begin with a conversation about your yard and what you want to achieve.

item1.title: Sod installation
item1.copy: Bring a fresh layer of grass to the areas of your property you want to turn into lawn.

item2.title: Your space, considered
item2.copy: Share the size, current condition, and location of the area so we can discuss the project you have in mind.

item3.title: Part of a bigger picture
item3.copy: If your lawn is one piece of a landscaping refresh, tell us about nearby beds and other areas you’d like to improve.

detail.planningTitle: Show us the space you’re starting with.
detail.planningCopy: Current photos and approximate dimensions help start the conversation. Mention the condition of the area and ask about preparation, scheduling, and care for the new lawn when discussing your estimate.

item1.question: What information helps with a sod estimate?
item1.answer: Share your address, photos of the area, and approximate dimensions if you have them. Let us know whether it is an existing lawn or a new area for grass.

item2.question: Can sod be part of a landscaping project?
item2.answer: Yes, you can discuss sod installation alongside our landscaping services. Tell us about the full project so the areas you want to improve can be considered together.

item3.question: When should I ask about care for the new lawn?
item3.answer: Bring up watering, mowing, and use of the lawn while discussing your project. Ask the team for guidance suited to the sod and work agreed for your property.
